name: Alamar Grimm
summary: At Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Alamar Grimm teaches young gnomes to wield fel magic. Since Gnomeregan fell, he has grown bitter toward outsiders and means to teach his students to summon an imp.

sections.title: A Bitter Exile
sections.body: At Anvilmar, Alamar Grimm still resents the fall of Gnomeregan. While other gnomes in Coldridge Valley work to recover and tinker, he distrusts ordinary adventurers and even the Ironforge dwarves sheltering his people. He grumbles that their allies care more for diplomacy with humans than for reclaiming the fallen city. Alamar seeks those who share his belief that his people may need ruthless power.

sections.title: Master of the Dark Arts
sections.body: Alamar Grimm guides young gnomes who take up fel magic. A tainted memorandum earns a rare warm welcome, and he begins teaching basic spells. Before sharing the dangerous knowledge needed to bind a demonic imp, he demands proof of each novice's magical and physical endurance. He sends them to retrieve strange feather charms carried by local Frostmane troll novices.

faq.answer: Alamar Grimm trains gnome warlocks at Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches new students basic fel magic and how to summon their first imp.

faq.q: Why is Alamar Grimm angry at the dwarves?
faq.answer: Alamar resents the Ironforge dwarves because he believes reclaiming Gnomeregan matters less to them than their alliance with humans. Though they shelter the displaced gnomes, he feels they do not put his people's homeland first.

faq.q: What does Alamar Grimm ask new warlocks to do?
faq.answer: Alamar Grimm asks novice warlocks to gather feather charms from local Frostmane troll novices. He uses the charms to test their stamina and magical ability before teaching them to summon an imp.

angles.text: As a gnome warlock starting in Coldridge Valley, you learn your first spells from Alamar Grimm. You must prove your worth to earn your first imp.
As a gnome, you may share the bitterness of exiles who feel abandoned by their allies while Gnomeregan remains in trogg hands.
